themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/Use complaints exploded to 62 THIS WEEK, up 978% from the 8-week average of 5.8 weekly complaints (z-score: 17.84), suggesting a potential enforcement action, unsafe condition cluster, or major violation discovery in Sunset Park residential or commercial properties.
evidence: 62 Building/Use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 5.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
z-score of 17.84 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
612 total DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (427 alterations) suggests active construction/renovation activity may be triggering violations
reporting_angles: Which specific buildings or blocks are driving the spike? Are violations concentrated in one neighborhood area or building type?
Interview DOB inspectors and residents about what triggered the sudden increase — gas/electrical work, illegal conversions, occupancy violations?

themes_detail.label: Neighborhood Noise Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Three noise-related complaint categories spiked THIS WEEK and LAST 2 WEEKS: general Noise (26 THIS WEEK vs. 9.5 avg, +174%), Noise-Park (4 THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 avg, +700%), and Noise-Street/Sidewalk (49 TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 13.5 avg, +263%), suggesting a sustained pattern of disruptive activity across multiple public spaces.
evidence: General Noise: 26 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 9.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.49)
Noise-Park: 4 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.95)
Noise-Street/Sidewalk: 49 complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 13.5 weekly average (z-score: 4.74)
Community board has repeatedly requested park expansions and improvements, suggesting existing parks may be overwhelmed or poorly managed
reporting_angles: Talk to residents in or near parks (Prospect Park area, waterfront parks) about what changed — construction, street vendors, events, nightlife?
Interview NYPD about noise enforcement patterns and whether they're responding adequately

themes_detail.label: Animal Incidents in Parks
themes_detail.summary: Animal in a Park complaints spiked to 6 THIS WEEK, up 860% from the 8-week average of 0.6 weekly complaints (z-score: 6.27), indicating a sudden emergence of wildlife or loose pet incidents in Sunset Park's green spaces.
evidence: 6 Animal in a Park complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average (z-score: 6.27)
Spike coincides with noise complaints in parks, suggesting possible behavioral changes in animal populations or increased park usage
reporting_angles: What animals are being reported? (coyotes, raccoons, loose dogs, pigeons) and which parks?
Interview Parks Dept. on whether there's been a documented increase in wildlife activity or if residents are more vigilant

themes_detail.label: Food Poisoning Reports Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Food Poisoning complaints peaked at 3 TWO WEEKS AGO, up 700% from the 8-week average of 0.4 weekly complaints (z-score: 5.42), suggesting a possible foodborne illness outbreak or contamination incident linked to one or more Sunset Park food vendors or restaurants.
evidence: 3 Food Poisoning complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 5.42)
Timing 2 weeks ago suggests potential window for identifying the source before current week
reporting_angles: Cross-reference 311 complaints with NYC Health Dept. inspection data — which restaurants/food vendors were flagged in the timeframe?
Interview Health Dept. about whether they've identified a common source and what follow-up enforcement has occurred

themes_detail.label: Sewer System Stress
themes_detail.summary: Sewer complaints spiked to 26 THREE WEEKS AGO, up 433% from the 8-week average of 4.9 weekly complaints (z-score: 4.32), potentially indicating aging infrastructure problems or a localized system failure in Sunset Park's water/sewer network.
evidence: 26 Sewer complaints 3 WEEKS AGO vs. 4.9 weekly average (z-score: 4.32)
Water System also elevated in 90-day totals (308 complaints), suggesting broader water infrastructure stress
Community board budget requests include transit/infrastructure upgrades but no specific sewer requests visible
reporting_angles: Which neighborhoods in CD307 experienced sewer issues? Were they clustered geographically suggesting a specific line failure?
Interview NYC DEP about aging sewer infrastructure in Sunset Park and what capital projects are planned
